test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All huts are houses.

No villa is a house.

Some buildings are villas.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some buildings are huts.

II. Some houses are buildings.

III. No hut is a villa.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is given below according to information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/944b131ee43246cdbaf4e5a98b0df96dbdb38773390a9ace0237593960c8bfd6.png] 

I. Some buildings are huts → Does not follow→ (As, all huts are houses, some buildings are villas and no villa is house. So some buildings are huts is not definite true)
